subject: SOC2 evidence handoff & SOW discussion with compliance vendors
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan@drata-eval.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC2 evidence handoff & SOW discussion with compliance vendors

Team + Jordan —

Thanks for the demo last week. Jordan, per our follow-up notes we want to move from evaluation -> paid pilot for the SOC2 evidence automation scope. Before contracting, Legal and Security want a clear SOW that lays out: evidence handoff responsibilities, API access requirements (read-only), data retention limits, and a proposed timeline for the evidence collection windows.

Attached is the internal gap analysis we ran on our side (SOC2_gap_analysis.pdf) — it highlights the biggest evidence gathering items we expect to hand off (access logs, IAM lists, backup configs). Two asks from our side to start:
- Can you provide a draft SOW that includes roles/responsibilities and an itemized effort estimate?
- Can you confirm what evidence types you can ingest automatically vs. what will require manual upload/connector assistance?

Marissa, Vivek — looping you in for redlines and security constraints. Laura, can you confirm procurement steps and PO cadence once Legal signs?

Next step: If Jordan can send a draft SOW by end of day Wednesday we can have Legal review and come back with redlines.

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: SOC2_gap_analysis.pdf (pdf)]

From: Jordan Smith <jordan@drata-eval.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 evidence handoff & SOW discussion with compliance vendors

Hi Karthik + team —

Thanks for the clear ask. Attached is a first-pass SOW that maps our standard evidence connectors and the manual collection items (Drata_SOW_v1.pdf). High level:
- Automatic connectors: AWS CloudTrail, GCP audit logs, Okta, Datadog ingestion for agentless logs.
- Manual items: legacy backup configs, offline device inventories (we provide a secure upload portal).
- Timeline: 4-week onboarding (connectors + verification), then 1 week of gap remediation support.

On data: we operate in a tenanted environment with encryption at rest and in transit. We can offer a 30-day retention for logs in the evaluation environment, and enterprise retention policies in production.

I included an estimated cost for the pilot in the appendix of the SOW. Happy to hop on a call to walk through specifics.

Jordan Smith
Solutions Engineering
Drata Evaluation Team
jordan@drata-eval.com

[Attachment: Drata_SOW_v1.pdf (pdf)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jordan Smith <jordan@drata-eval.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 14:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 evidence handoff & SOW discussion with compliance vendors

Jordan —

Thanks for the draft. I reviewed Drata_SOW_v1.pdf and have initial redlines attached (Redlines_Drata_SOW.docx). Primary Legal asks:
- Clarify data handling: specify that Drata will act as a processor for evidence ingestion and not a controller; include a data deletion SLA post-evaluation (7 days unless otherwise agreed).
- Indemnity cap: propose limiting to direct damages only and carve out specific security exceptions.
- Subprocessor notice: require 30-day notice before onboarding any new subprocessor.

Also need to confirm whether the SOW references any change to our Master Services Agreement; if so, please surface the change summary so Legal can align.

I can do a quick sync with Jordan tomorrow morning if that's helpful.

Best,
Marissa
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: Redlines_Drata_SOW.docx (docx)]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Smith <jordan@drata-eval.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 evidence handoff & SOW discussion with compliance vendors

Quick security note following my review of Drata_SOW_v1.pdf:

Thanks — good first pass. A few items we need included in the SOW or an appendix for procurement to accept:
- Responsibility matrix (who pulls what): we need explicit owner for IAM lists (infra), backup configs (infra), endpoint inventory (security ops).
- Access model: read-only API keys scoped to specific resources, rotate keys every 30 days during pilot.
- Evidence verification: timeline for verification errors (48 hours) and remediation SLA (10 business days).
- Audit logs export: we require a delivery mechanism that allows us to ingest vendor-provided evidence into our internal evidence store for future audits.

I've attached a control mapping workbook that maps items from our gap analysis to typical SOC2 CC and CC controls (SOC2_Controls_Matrix.xlsx). Please review and incorporate into the SOW appendix so reviewers can see end-to-end coverage.

Vivek
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: SOC2_Controls_Matrix.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Jordan Smith <jordan@drata-eval.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 evidence handoff & SOW discussion with compliance vendors

Thanks all — Jordan, appreciate the quick turnaround and the SOW.

Marissa: we'll review redlines and I think the data deletion SLA + subprocessor notice are reasonable asks. Vivek: thanks for the mapping — that will make the acceptance criteria clearer.

Proposed next steps:
- Jordan: please ingest Marissa's redlines into a tracked SOW, and update the SOW appendix with the controls matrix excerpt.
- Legal/Security: we'll aim to complete review by EOD Monday (26 July).
- Procurement (Laura): once Legal signs off we will issue a PO; please confirm your PO lead time.
- Quick sync: can we do a 30-minute call Thursday at 10:00 AM PT to align on action items? If that works I will send a calendar invite and include the internal sync doc here: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c4d_internal_sow_notes

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference
